subtitle: Lesson 33 · Capstone: Platform Fundamentals in Practice

code:
System Definition > Tables > incident
  Extends table: task   (confirmed, not assumed)

Same check on:
  problem           -> Extends table: task
  change_request    -> Extends table: task
caption: The task hierarchy this whole ITSM suite is built on.

code:
System Definition > Dictionary > filter: incident

Each entry shows:  column name  |  label  |  type
caption: You don't need all 100+ fields — just the ones that explain behavior.

steps.label: priority
steps.sub: Choice field — fixed value list, which is what makes reporting reliable

steps.label: caller_id
steps.sub: Reference field — stores a sys_id pointing at sys_user, not a typed name

steps.label: work_notes
steps.sub: Journal field — appends new entries instead of overwriting the last one

eyebrow: Related lists on a real record
